title: Heaven and Hell: The Last Enemy
premise: A weakened demon wakes on an old battlefield and must steal strength and identities to survive long enough to reach the rightful king in the old city.
knownAtStart: The player is a weak demon or spirit that can drain or possess living bodies.
The opening battlefield is the scar of an older war involving several peoples.
The old city in the northeast is ruled by a rightful king protected by powerful forces.
mysteries: Why the demon needs the king dead.
How the battlefield, the Forge Kingdom, and the current conflicts connect.
